Help/Reviewing and sharing/What your client sees

What your client sees, and views and taps

Your client opens a page with the listing’s name, the walkthrough and your contact card. They never need an account or an app.

The page

  • The walkthrough, with a short line: "Captured on site with an iPhone. Not to scale."
  • Moving around: drag to look, tap the floor or a numbered circle to walk, and use the arrows to go room to room.
  • Your contact card, with Call and Email buttons that reach you directly.
  • A Share button, so they can forward it to a partner.

Your contact card

In your Veylet account, under What your clients see, enter your name, agency, phone and email, and turn on Show on shared walkthroughs. Only what you enter is shown.

Views and taps

Each live walkthrough’s card in your account shows how often it was opened, for example "Opened 3 times", when it was last opened, and how many times people tapped Call and Email. "Not opened yet." means no one has opened it.

If it doesn’t work

If your client sees "This walkthrough isn’t available right now", sharing is paused or off. See pause or turn off sharing.

"This link looks incomplete" means part of the link was lost when it was copied. Send it again.

The listing URL for portals never shows your contact card.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
